parsed.why: No trans-specific offence, no facility ban, no documented anti-trans violence; courts now transcribe foreign gender markers. Counterweights: hostile official rhetoric, blocked/fined Prides, no gender-identity hate-crime coverage. Reduced Risk, below acceptance-with-protections.

Universal border exposure: sex-at-birth passports/visas, discrepancy refusal plus possible lifetime fraud bar, documented foreign detentions and eight allied advisories; bathroom bans criminal in four states; custody harms, few working remedies.

No criminalisation, no facility restriction, marriage and adoption open, no recorded anti-trans harm or border friction; gaps are resident-facing (no gender-identity law or marker change) plus church/monarch disapproval, thin 2012 social snapshot.

Dormant colonial felonies (up to 14 years) with no prosecutions recorded since 2013 and no documented police targeting; no gender-identity protection or recourse, island-scale visibility, but a recognised third-gender tradition softens presentation norms.

Enforced criminalisation plus advocacy law reaching gender-expression; documented cross-dressing arrests, 2023 conviction and jailing, police sexual coercion, impunity, HIV care denied in custody, capital police 'merciless' to LGBT tourists.
